tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && cat pipeline/processor.go pipeline/stage_input.go pipeline/stage_validation.go pipeline/stage_normalization.go pipeline/stage_mapping.go pipeline/stage_routing.go'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os

root = Path('.')
renames = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
}
for path in sorted(root.glob('pipeline/*.go')):
    if path.name.endswith('_test.go'):
        continue
    original = path.read_text()
    updated = original
    for old, new in renames.items():
        updated = updated.replace(old, new)
    if updated == original:
        continue
    temp = path.with_name(path.name + '.tmp')
    with temp.open('w') as f:
        f.write(updated)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(temp, path)
PY
rg -n '\\b(LoadInput|CheckInput|NormalizeValue|MapFields|RouteValue|ReadRequest|ValidateRequest|CanonicalizeValue|ProjectFields|DispatchValue)\\b' pipeline --glob '*.go'"
